cves.headline: Langflow 1.0.0 to 1.10.3 lets an authenticated user run code via a hash collision

name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
title: CWE-326: Inadequate Encryption Strength
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in LLM application builders, as the single CVE here shows. CVE-2026-9201 affects Langflow, the visual framework for building LLM applications and agents, across versions 1.0.0 to 1.10.3. The weak encryption is reached through normal authenticated use of the product, so a logged in user is enough. The inadequate strength of the scheme lets that user cause a hash collision and then run code through it. The result is code execution inside the Langflow environment, which can expose the flows, credentials and connected model services the application holds.
description: The product stores or transmits sensitive data using an encryption scheme that is theoretically sound, but is not strong enough for the level of protection required.

mitigations.description: Use an encryption scheme that is currently considered to be strong by experts in the field.

consequences.note: An attacker may be able to decrypt the data using brute force attacks.

extended_description: A weak encryption scheme can be subjected to brute force attacks that have a reasonable chance of succeeding using current attack methods and resources.
